verdict.rationale: A government business-filing portal could plausibly offer a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies. The pack shows no AI assistant that takes delegated tasks. 'Corporations & Charities Live Chat' is not described as AI-driven, and the Business Licensing Wizard is a guided questionnaire, not task delegation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
